_comment: Reference profile. Copy to hive.config.default.json (or hive.config.<profile>.json) and hand-edit. All `_comment` keys are ignored by the loader. Groups, top to bottom: roles (edited most), stages, targets, ops, providers (set once).

roles._comment: Each role = provider + model. provider: copilot | codex | openai. copilot ceiling is sonnet (no opus); openai is the OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint (see providers.openai).

scout._comment: Reinforcement worker; falls back to roles.swarm when omitted.

judge._comment: votes_per_axis ~5 = best-of-N voting; max_total_calls 0 = unlimited. max_parallel = V, max_axes = 2 x V, max_total_calls = 0.8 x V x max_axes.

reinvestigation._comment: Live re-run of a needs_reinvestigation; OFF by default (plan still logged for free).

targets._comment: Per-codebase DB (converge data-read, read-only) + test runner (red->green verify). Key matches the --codebase leaf folder name (case-insensitive).

swarm_run._comment: true allows the expensive full-swarm run; false restricts to the cheap investigate path.

codex._comment: Codex CLI. lock_timeout_sec (seconds) = cross-process serialization mutex wait bound (how long a queued codex call waits before TimeoutError). Change the number here.

openai._comment: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. base_url = chat-completions root; api_key_env = NAME of the env var holding the key (the key lives in the out-of-repo secrets file).
